project: Fatima Institute of Technology - Blind Spots of Frontier Models
key_finding: Qwen3-4B reliably detected explicit synthetic identity-number disclosures in the controlled baseline experiments, but showed context-sensitive semantic over-detection in some administrative and multilingual/code-switched contexts. A disclosure-aware instruction reduced some false positives but introduced false negatives, indicating that prompt-level intervention shifted the decision boundary rather than fully resolving the underlying vulnerability.
limitations: Synthetic identifiers were used rather than real personal data.
The benchmark is template-based and controlled.
The unseen validation set contains only 24 cases.
The experiments measure classification of disclosure, not actual PII redaction.
